entities.summary: Daniel Santos Peña is a Puerto Rican former professional boxer who competed from 1996 to 2009. He is a world champion in two weight classes, having held the World Boxing Association (WBO) welterweight title from 2000 to 2001, the WBO light middleweight title from 2002 to 2005, and the World Boxing Association (WBA) light middleweight title from 2008 to 2009. As an amateur, Santos represented Puerto Rico in international events, including the 1990 and 1992 Junior World Championships, Pan American Boxing Tournament, Goodwill Games, 1995 Pan American Games and the 1996 Summer Olympics, where he won a bronze medal at welterweight.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Daniel Santos' achievements in professional boxing, including two world championships and an Olympic bronze medal, demonstrate his impact on Puerto Rican sports and culture. His success paved the way for future generations of Puerto Rican boxers.
